question: The perimeter of a rectangle is 26 cm and its length is 7 cm. Find its area in cm².
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of length and breadth = Perimeter ÷ 2 = 26 ÷ 2 = 13 cm.

Since the length is 7 cm, the breadth is 13 − 7 = 6 cm.

Area = length × breadth = 7 × 6 = 42 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 42 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Perimeter of the rectangle = 26 cm

Length (l) = 7 cm

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter = 2(l + b)

Area = l × b

 
 Length (l) = 7 cm
 Breadth (b) = 6 cm
 Area = ?

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2(l + b) = 26

⇒ 7 + b = 13

⇒ b = 13 − 7 = 6 cm

⇒ Area = l × b

⇒ Area = 7 × 6 = 42 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 42 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Diagonal of a Rectangle

The length of the diagonal d of a rectangle can be calculated using the formula d = √(l² + b²).

Square Properties

A square is a special type of rectangle where all four sides are equal (length = breadth = a). Its Perimeter = 4a and Area = a².

Area of Four Walls of a Room

Also known as the lateral surface area of a cuboid, it is calculated as Area = 2(l + b) × h, where h is the height of the room.
